title: The Summons
recap: The President summoned Santa to Washington and handed him a gold dossier on the villains stealing Christmas.

title: The Frozen Workshop
recap: Jack Frost froze the North Pole solid. Santa relit the three workshop furnaces, climbed the Clock Tower and drove Frost off with the clock's own steam, but Frost's parting blizzard clipped Blitzen's wing.

hints.start: Stay warm between jumps! Every brazier tops your warmth up, and so does a furnace once it's lit.
hints.workshop: Stay warm between jumps! Every brazier tops your warmth up, and so does a furnace once it's lit. Take your run-up with Shift for the longer gaps.
hints.clock_tower: No rush on the tower. Warm up at each lantern on the way, and wait for the moving planks to come right up to the edge before you step on.
hints.boss: Punching Frost's ice does nothing. Watch which gear glows blue: that's where he'll hop. Turn the crank so the clock's hand points at that gear's pipe, and the steam melts his armour. Then punch him!

title: Krampusnacht
recap: Elves were snatched on Krampusnacht and hung in sacks from an Alpine bell tower. Pepper stowed away in the sleigh, Santa fought through Krampus's helpers, rang the church bells and beat his old partner with his own chain, then let him go. Pepper found goat hair on the sack ropes.

hints.flight: Nothing can go wrong on the flight. Steer with A and D or the mouse, and fly through the gold rings to refill your boost.
hints.village: Block with right-click or R just as a helper swings its claws: it'll stagger, and then your punches land free. Your health creeps back if you keep out of trouble for a bit.
hints.square: Go for the helpers carrying sacks first. Knock one down, then press E by the dropped sack to free the elf. The ones still waiting at the tower can wait.
hints.boss: In the dark nothing hurts Krampus. Go to the church door and press E to ring the bells. Then don't just punch: block his chain with right-click or R as it lashes, and while you hold it, attack to slam him.

title: The Paper Monopoly
recap: Scrooge & Co. bought every paper mill on Earth. Santa couldn't outbid Golden Tower money, so he won the workers over instead, and the shareholders voted the paper back. Scrooge handed over contracts signed by Golden Tower Holdings, and went to supper in Camden Town.

hints.start: Bidding never works: Scrooge's backers always pay more. Build elf mills on our land and buy the suppliers early, then be kind to his workers. Wages, toys and meals fill a town's ring until it strikes and comes over to us.
hints.day5: Pick one town and fill its ring before moving on: Scrooge's bonus only goes to the warmest town, a little each night. Don't give the same kindness twice running, it only counts half. Press Ask Pepper if you're stuck!
hints.day9: Count the votes at the top. Towns are worth 2, suppliers 1, and Scrooge has 2 of his own. Keep enough coins back for tonight's bills, or we go bankrupt.
hints.vote: We need more towns on our side before the vote. Raised wages warm a town every day by themselves, so raise them early. Press Ask Pepper for a plan.
